# MODEL: Three-agent recursive strategic model with 6 states (s0-s5)

# PURPOSE: Recursive strategic reasoning with cost constraints.

# LOGIC: RABATL

# DESCRIPTION: Three agents; coalitions reason about other coalitions'
# strategies under cost bounds. Use for strategic dependencies under
# resource limits. ^ is idle. In s0 and s2 the joint actions that lead
# nowhere else keep the state, at cost 0.
